text_description: Cropped runway-style look shown from head to upper thighs, built around an ivory and brown palette with gold hardware. The outer layer is a cream cropped jacket with a boxy, slightly structured silhouette, broad notched lapels, lightly padded-looking shoulders, long straight sleeves, and a short hem ending above the natural waist; it has visible gold-tone buttons down the front and matching gold buttons at the wide sleeve cuffs, with small black side inset details visible near the lower sides. Underneath is a close-fitting cream knit top or cardigan with a soft open neckline, a short front placket fastened by small gold buttons, and a bold black interlocking loop motif centered across the chest. The bottom is a pair of high-waisted dark brown leather or leather-like trousers with a glossy surface, roomy pleated hips, front pocket openings, and two vertical rows of gold buttons at the waistband/front yoke, creating a sailor-pant effect; the trousers sit high under the cropped jacket, emphasizing a long lower-body proportion. Styling includes a short red-and-dark beaded necklace, colorful statement earrings, a glimpse of a textured dark handbag held at one side, and a polished, tailored-luxury mood with retro nautical hardware accents.
